sentence: This project builds a system that connects data repositories and computing facilities so researchers can use them together for AI-driven discovery.
This project creates courses and interactive books on machine learning and high-performance computing for studying space weather.
This project builds a framework that runs and compares computational tools for studying biological networks.
This project builds a system that securely shares crop data from farms and uses deep learning to predict plant stress and detect pathogens.
This project studies how epigenetic factors control duplicate genes and help them stay and gain new functions over time.
This project studies how warming streams affect cutthroat trout and the tailed frog tadpoles they eat, using DNA sequencing and computer models.
This project studies how communities along the coast managed fisheries and shellfisheries over time, using archaeological, ecological and geochemical methods.
This project studies how saltier lakes change Daphnia and the food web they belong to, using field surveys and lab experiments.
This project tests whether proteins that bind DNA make it easier to damage or harder to repair, using UV light.
This project builds a community effort that gathers open-source technologies for the design, fabrication and modeling of soft robotics.
This project studies monomial ideals in polynomial rings and parking functions, including Stirling permutations and tiered parking functions.
This project builds a free toolkit with an assessment and instructional materials for teaching people to read biotechnology diagrams.
This project studies attacks on how Next Generation networks share resources and builds secure ways to manage them.
This project offers a summer program on semiconductor fabrication in a cleanroom and on four emerging nanotechnology areas.
This project develops ways to make artificial intelligence safe, accurate and accountable, including how to audit deployed AI models.
This project builds safer and more secure neural implant devices and tests them for attacks on their chips and software.
This project uses CRISPR to build cells that sense stress from making proteins and adjust to keep producing them.
